# Official Unicode grapheme fixture

- File: `GraphemeBreakTest-17.0.0.txt`, Unicode **17.0.0**, 766 cases.
- Source: https://www.unicode.org/Public/17.0.0/ucd/auxiliary/GraphemeBreakTest.txt
- Downloaded: 2026-11-06. Original bytes and copyright header retained.
- SHA-256: `e2d134d2c52919bace503ebb6a551c1855fe1a1faec18478c78fff254a1793ec`.
- License: Unicode License V3; accompanying unmodified `UNICODE-LICENSE.txt` downloaded from https://www.unicode.org/license.txt on the same date.
- License SHA-256: `e7a93b009565cfce55919a381437ac4db883e9da2126fa28b91d12732bc53d96`.
- Terms identifying the license for Unicode Data Files: https://www.unicode.org/copyright.html (section 3.3).

`../grapheme-conformance.test.ts` reads this fixture offline and checks all UTF-16 boundary positions, segment counts, segment contents and exact reconstruction against `graphemeSegments` from the project-pinned `unicode-segmenter` 0.17.3 dependency. It also verifies the fixture version, byte hash and case count, so accidental replacement or truncation fails.

This fixture tests Unicode segmentation, including control-character cases. It is intentionally independent of the application's message-validation policy, which can reject some of these strings. Passing this suite does not establish rendering, font coverage, screen-reader pronunciation, Android/iOS behavior, authentication or backend authorization.

For a Unicode-version upgrade, fetch the matching official version explicitly, retain its notice and license, update the filename/hash/count and run the whole suite. Do not silently substitute a latest-version URL or tests generated by the implementation under test.
